generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall be either the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized dealer/channel partner of the OEM and should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work as Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Battery Bank and Battery Charger in any power generating station OR industry OR organization OR Local bodies corporation of value not less than Rs.11.83 Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any one of the preceding five years. Work order and Work done certificates issued by the competent authority shall be enclosed as a documentary proof. Cost of completed works of previous years will be given 10 per cent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.

The intending bidder should have an average annual financial turnover of not be less than Rs.23.65 Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any of the two financial years in preceding five financial years. A self-attested copy of Auditors report along with the Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss statements & turnover certificates shall be enclosed as a documentary proof. Financial Turnover of previous years will be given 10 per cent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.
